keywords: The 5th Respondent had made an application to the 1st Respondent in terms of Section 2 of the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act, No 45 of 1971 (as amended), to place certain employees including the Petitioners on half-pay basis for six months due to standstill of its operations; application was allowed; Petitioners challenged the same on the basis that such decision was ultra vires. Held – 1 st Respondent has enormous powers under the Act. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
